# NerdsNote

> NerdsNote is a free, private, local-first online notepad for distraction-free writing in the browser. Notes are stored locally on the user's own device by default — no account, no server — with optional read-only share links.

Key facts:

- Free to use, with no account or login required.
- Privacy-first: notes are saved in the browser's local storage by default and are never uploaded unless the user deliberately creates a share link.
- Works offline once the app has loaded.
- Plain-text focused: import `.txt` and `.md` files, export portable plain text.
- Additional features: autosave, dark mode, instant search across notes, full-screen focus mode, and optional local folder sync in supported browsers.
- Built and maintained by Khueon Studios.
